reason: The hypothesis directly transfers the microstructural engineering approach (annealing at 600°C to form ductile precipitates) from Al0.5NbTa0.8Ti1.5V0.2Zr (P6, P9) to the different alloy HfZrTiTa0.53, but provides no mechanistic justification for why this specific treatment would work in a chemically distinct system, and the proposed mechanism of 'ultrafine, ductile precipitates' nucleating at grain boundaries is a generic restatement of the prior work's concept without new insight.
